labs.name: Ubuntu Playground
labs.description: Full interactive Ubuntu 24.04 LTS sandbox container equipped with bash, curl, wget, git, iproute2, vim, nano, and python.
labs.instructionsMarkdown:
# Ubuntu 24.04 Playground

Welcome to your isolated **Ubuntu 24.04** container environment running as a Kubernetes pod.

## Prerequisites & Tools
This container comes pre-configured with:
- `bash`
- `curl`, `wget`, `git`
- `iproute2` (`ip a`, `ip route`), `net-tools`
- `procps` (`ps aux`, `top`)
- `vim`, `nano`

---

## Guided Exercises

### Step 1: Inspect System Release & Kernel
Run the following command in the interactive terminal on the right to view your OS version:

```bash
cat /etc/os-release
uname -a
```

### Step 2: Working Directory & Environment Variables
Check your current working directory and active shell environment:

```bash
pwd
whoami
env | grep USER
```

### Step 3: Create a DevOps Workspace Directory
Create a directory named `devops` in your home directory:

```bash
mkdir -p ~/devops && cd ~/devops
pwd
```

---

## Tasks Checklist

tasks.title: Check Ubuntu OS Version
tasks.description: Execute `cat /etc/os-release` in the terminal to verify the container image.

tasks.title: Create ~/devops Directory
tasks.description: Create a directory named `devops` inside your home directory.

tasks.title: Create hello.txt file
tasks.description: Write "Welcome to BYOLabs" into a file named `hello.txt` inside ~/devops.
tasks.validationScript: grep -i "Welcome to BYOLabs" ~/devops/hello.txt || grep -i "Welcome to BYOLabs" /root/devops/hello.txt

labs.name: Linux Fundamentals & File Permissions
labs.description: Master core Linux shell navigation, file manipulation, file permissions (chmod, chown), and process management.
labs.instructionsMarkdown:
# Linux Fundamentals & File System Permissions

Learn essential file ownership and permission control in Linux environments.

## Quick Commands
- `chmod 755 filename`
- `chown user:group filename`
- `ls -la`

```bash
touch sample.sh
chmod +x sample.sh
./sample.sh
```

tasks.title: Make Script Executable
tasks.description: Create a script `/tmp/run.sh` and make it executable with `chmod +x /tmp/run.sh`.

labs.name: Docker Playground
labs.description: Interactive Docker Playground powered by official docker:dind image with instant startup and full root access.
labs.instructionsMarkdown:
# Docker Playground (Ubuntu 24.04 Engine)

Welcome to your isolated **Docker Playground** running on **Ubuntu 24.04 LTS**!

---

## Environment Architecture
- **Operating System**: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
- **Docker Engine**: Installed automatically on boot via official `curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh` script
- **Daemon**: `dockerd` running natively in background with full container creation capability

---

## Guided Exercises

### Step 1: Verify Installed Docker Engine & Daemon
Verify CLI communication with the Docker daemon:

```bash
docker version
docker info
```

### Step 2: Test Container Lifecycle & Hello-World
Run a lightweight `hello-world` container:

```bash
docker run hello-world
```

### Step 3: Pull & Inspect Alpine Linux Image
Pull the official `alpine` image:

```bash
docker pull alpine
docker images
```

---

## Tasks Checklist

tasks.title: 1. Verify Docker Daemon Connection (docker version)
tasks.description: Execute `docker version` or `docker info` in the terminal to confirm CLI connection to the rootless daemon.

tasks.title: 2. Run Hello-World Container
tasks.description: Run `docker run hello-world` in terminal.
tasks.validationScript: docker ps -a | grep -i "hello-world" || docker images | grep -q "hello-world"

tasks.title: 3. Pull Alpine Image
tasks.description: Execute `docker pull alpine` in terminal.
tasks.validationScript: docker image inspect alpine >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker images | grep -q "alpine"

labs.name: Kubernetes Pods & Workload Basics
labs.description: Learn Kubernetes concepts, pod specifications, deployments, namespaces, and YAML manifests.
labs.instructionsMarkdown:
# Kubernetes Basics & Workloads

Learn how Kubernetes manifests configure Pod specs and deployments.

```bash
cat << 'EOF' > pod.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: nginx-pod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:alpine
EOF
cat pod.yaml
```

tasks.title: Create Pod Manifest
tasks.description: Create a file named `pod.yaml` containing a valid Kubernetes Pod specification.

labs.name: Git Version Control & Branching
labs.description: Practice git initialization, commits, branching strategies, merge conflict resolution, and rebase operations.
labs.instructionsMarkdown:
# Git Branching & Version Control

Practice initializing repositories and managing branches.

```bash
mkdir my-repo && cd my-repo
git init
git config user.name "Student"
git config user.email "student@byolabs.in"
echo "Initial commit" > README.md
git add .
git commit -m "Initial commit"
```

tasks.title: Initialize Git Repo
tasks.description: Initialize a git repository in a directory named `my-repo` and create a initial commit.

labs.name: RHCSA & CLA Module 1 Gradable Tasks
labs.description: Unnati Development and Training Center RHCSA+CLA Module 1 practical gradable task suite covering file creation, directory trees, process output redirection, file relocation, and hidden files.
labs.instructionsMarkdown:
# RHCSA & CLA Module 1 Gradable Tasks
*Unnati Development and Training Center*

Welcome to your Linux RHCSA & CLA Module 1 practical lab environment. Execute the commands in the terminal window to fulfill all 12 gradable task requirements.

tasks.title: 1. Create /root/myfile.doc with directory path
tasks.description: Create a file named "/root/myfile.doc" and store the location of the "/root" directory within it.

tasks.title: 2. Generate file1, file2, file3 simultaneously
tasks.description: Generate three files "file1", "file2", and "file3" simultaneously in the "/root" directory.

tasks.title: 3. Store current date in /date.txt
tasks.description: Store the current date output in a file named "/date.txt".

tasks.title: 4. Save /bin listing into /list.txt
tasks.description: Retrieve a list of files and directories from the "/bin" folder and save it in "/list.txt".

tasks.title: 5. Record username and working directory
tasks.description: Record the username and current working directory in "/root/mydata/userfile.txt".

tasks.title: 6. Establish directory /root/unnati/cidco/aurangabad
tasks.description: Establish a collaborative directory path at "/root/unnati/cidco/aurangabad".

tasks.title: 7. Generate linuxdata1 to linuxdata10 folders
tasks.description: Generate ten folders named "linuxdata1" to "linuxdata10" within the "/root" directory.
tasks.validationScript: for i in $(seq 1 10); do test -d "/root/linuxdata$i" || exit 1; done

tasks.title: 8. Create reddata path and unnati1.php..10.php
tasks.description: Create directory path "/root/data/gdata/reddata" and generate ten .php files named "unnati1.php" through "unnati10.php".
tasks.validationScript: for i in $(seq 1 10); do test -f "/root/data/gdata/reddata/unnati$i.php" || exit 1; done

tasks.title: 9. Duplicate /etc/fstab to /root/mdata/fstab.backup
tasks.description: Duplicate the file "/etc/fstab" and store the duplicate as "/root/mdata/fstab.backup".

tasks.title: 10. Create & relocate XML and HTML app files
tasks.description: Create appfiles, move XML files to /tmp, and transfer HTML appfiles from /tmp to /tmp/kdata.
tasks.validationScript: for i in $(seq 1 5); do test -f "/tmp/appfile$i.xml" && test -f "/tmp/kdata/appfile$i.html" || exit 1; done

tasks.title: 11. Relocate fstab.backup to /tmp
tasks.description: Relocate the file "/root/mdata/fstab.backup" to "/tmp".

tasks.title: 12. Create hidden files .unnati1.xls to .unnati10.xls in /root
tasks.description: Create hidden files named ".unnati1.xls" through ".unnati10.xls" within the "/root" directory.
tasks.validationScript: for i in $(seq 1 10); do test -f "/root/.unnati$i.xls" || exit 1; done

labs.name: RHCSA & CLA Module 2 Gradable Tasks
labs.description: Unnati Development and Training Center RHCSA+CLA Module 2 practical gradable task suite covering user creation with UIDs/GIDs, group management, GECOS comments, non-interactive shells, secondary group assignments, password aging policies, account locking, and custom home directories.
labs.instructionsMarkdown:
# RHCSA & CLA Module 2 Gradable Tasks
*Unnati Development and Training Center Pvt Ltd*

Welcome to your Linux RHCSA & CLA Module 2 practical lab environment. Execute the commands in the terminal window to fulfill all 14 gradable user and group administration task requirements.

tasks.title: 1. Create user "vinay" with UID 4353
tasks.description: Create a user named "vinay" with the UID set to 4353.

tasks.title: 2. Create user "kiran" with GID 2083
tasks.description: Create a user named "kiran" with primary GID set to 2083.

tasks.title: 3. Set GECOS name of "vinay" as "developer2"
tasks.description: Set the GECOS name of the user "vinay" as "developer2".

tasks.title: 4. Create group "admin_java"
tasks.description: Create a group named "admin_java".

tasks.title: 5. Create group "ht_java" with GID 2076
tasks.description: Create a group named "ht_java" with the ID set to 2076.

tasks.title: 6. Create group "myadmin"
tasks.description: Create a group named "myadmin".

tasks.title: 7. Create group "super_admin"
tasks.description: Create a group named "super_admin".

tasks.title: 8. Create user "shrikant" with secondary groups "admin_java" and "myadmin"
tasks.description: Create a user named "shrikant" and add "shrikant" user to "admin_java" and "myadmin" secondary groups.
tasks.validationScript: id -Gn shrikant 2>/dev/null | grep -q "admin_java" && id -Gn shrikant 2>/dev/null | grep -q "myadmin"

tasks.title: 9. Create user "mahesh" with secondary groups "ht_java" and "super_admin"
tasks.description: Create a user named "mahesh" and add "mahesh" user to "ht_java" and "super_admin" secondary groups.
tasks.validationScript: id -Gn mahesh 2>/dev/null | grep -q "ht_java" && id -Gn mahesh 2>/dev/null | grep -q "super_admin"

tasks.title: 10. Create user "varsha" with UID 1089, GID 2076, and /sbin/nologin shell
tasks.description: Create user "varsha" with UID 1089, primary group GID 2076 (ht_java), and shell "/sbin/nologin".

tasks.title: 11. Configure password max age to 90 days for user "vinay"
tasks.description: Set the maximum password age policy to 90 days for user "vinay".
tasks.validationScript: getent shadow vinay 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f5 | grep -q "^90$" || chage -l vinay 2>/dev/null | grep -q "90"

tasks.title: 12. Lock user account "kiran"
tasks.description: Lock the user account for "kiran" to disable login access.
tasks.validationScript: getent shadow kiran 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f2 | grep -q "!" || passwd -S kiran 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "L|locked"

tasks.title: 13. Set account expiration date for user "mahesh"
tasks.description: Set the account expiration date for user "mahesh" to 2026-12-31.
tasks.validationScript: chage -l mahesh 2>/dev/null | grep -i "expires" | grep -v "never" || getent shadow mahesh 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f8 | grep -q "[0-9]"

tasks.title: 14. Create user "devops_admin" with custom home directory /home/devops_home
tasks.description: Create user "devops_admin" with home directory set to "/home/devops_home".
